messages:
Eli: Heads-up — Sapphire Payments is escalating. POC hit multiple blockers in this morning's demo: TLS peering latency, unexpected egress limits, and legal wants KMS attestation before data touch. CEO asked for an exec sync. Can we triage?

Maria: Short summary of what they need from us today?

Eli: They need: 1) Temporary allowlist for 3 IP ranges to validate Webhooks (they're in APAC), 2) KMS BYO info + attestation doc, 3) pricing for dedicated capacity (bursty txn spikes), 4) a stability plan if we hit seq len scaling. Want an exec bridge at 4pm PST.

Sam: I'll check network egress quotas and peering logs. @Kyle can you confirm throughput for 2x g5x2 nodes under websocket steady state? Need numbers in 30m.

Kyle: Running quick perf run now. Expect QPS + avg latency. will paste results.

Sam: Also sharing Cloud NAT error snippets: `curl: (28) Operation timed out` from their infra — looks like SNAT exhaustion.

Jorge: I have draft of KMS BYO checklist. Attestation we can provide: HSM vendor + cert + public key thumbprint. @Aditi please confirm legal/security language is ok.

Aditi: Legal wants: data flow diagram, retention table, KMS key lifecycle, and confirmation that keys never leave customer VPC. I can produce a short attestation template. Also needs SOC2 control numbers. ETA 2 hours.

Kyle: Perf run results: g5x2 x2 nodes, synthetic webhooks 500 rps -> p50 65ms, p95 240ms, CPU 68%, GPU mem 55%. With batching disabled latency drops small. I'll attach full logs: https://redwood.internal/jenkins/3367809123/perf

Maria: On pricing — they asked for a predictable committed tier with burst credits. @Eli do we have a standard term sheet? If not send baseline numbers and I can model cost delta.

Eli: I have term sheet draft. For exec bridge I propose: Sam (network), Kyle (perf), Aditi (security), Maria (pricing), Jorge (SE), Eli (AM). 4pm PST standup link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/3367809123. I asked Sapphire for their CISO and infra lead.

deploy-bot: env:prod -> canary deployed: inference-runtime v1.9.3 — no errors.

Maria: Action items: Sam->network logs & allowed IP ranges; Kyle->perf numbers + fallback plan (lower model size + quantized), Aditi->attestation + SOC2 refs, Jorge->KMS checklist, Eli->confirm exec bridge time with customer. I'll compile a one-pager after all inputs.

Sam: Network update — their infra uses ephemeral SNAT from 35.198.0.0/16, hitting 400 ephemeral ports. Immediate workaround: reserve static IPs and set up SNAT pool. I've opened a support ticket with infra: #INC-9923.

Aditi: Draft attestation uploaded: https://redwood.docs/attestations/sapphire-kms-draft.md — please review. Notes: keys are customer-managed, KMS HSM vendor = Azure Key Vault HSM, we provide audit logs via CloudTrail.

Eli: Thanks everyone. If we can get the attestation + perf numbers by 3:15pm PST I can run the exec bridge at 4pm. Quick question — pricing lead time for Dedicated commit?

Maria: 24 hours for initial quote, 48 hours for legal package.

Jorge: I'll prep a short runbook for post-demo failover: "If latency > 500ms -> fallback to smaller model + route to dedicated pool" — will post in thread.

Sam: Ticket INC-9923 created and assigned to eng-infra. Support SLA 4 hours.

Maria: One-pager posted: https://redwood.docs/presales/sapphire-onepager-3367809123.md

Eli: Final — customer confirmed exec bridge for 4pm with CISO attending. Spike plan looks good. I'll close this thread after bridge.
